items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Ernie Rappe was playing there then... They had this Ernie Rappe there, an American.

ctx.x: So you had been gone almost two years.

YEAH. Now, what the thing of it is, when I come back here, now Duke was just beginning to get started for the Cotton Club. But, I had the offer for the Cotton Club. But, at the same day, at this time, I had the offer for the Ufe PALAST Palace in Berlin. So at that time the Cotton Club was nothing.

Now I'd been there from the Club Alabam. I've got all America had to offer from the Club Alabam. See, now, why would I come back to Harlem to work at the Cotton Club. And, the Cotton Club wasn't no network or nothing like that then. So it was just another club in Harlem. Well the boys had been halfway around the world. They said, "Oh, no, we don't want to go back there. Why that's home. That won't do us any good." So the offer we accepted was the Ufe Palace. Ernie Rappe was playing there then, doing the same…
